common: Create a production 15-frame animation source atlas for our browser game. Reference1 is the actual Plants vs Zombies Lily Pad for anatomy; reference2 is approved rich 16-bit pixel style with crisp navy stepped outlines, saturated dimensional material ramps and pale cream background. Exact FIVE columns x THREE rows, 15 complete separated poses in equal square cells, constant character scale, generous margins. EVERY pose reads facing RIGHT in three-quarter top/front view. Entire pad/flowers inside cells. No text, labels, borders, water, ground, blue puddle, cast shadow, particles or detached projectiles. Character is a naturally FLAT HORIZONTAL broad GREEN lily pad with radial leaf veins, thick slightly upturned rim and an unmistakable triangular CLEFT NOTCH at its back-left edge. It is not a vertical stem-bodied plant. Two friendly DARK OVAL EYES with tiny white glints are on the pad's FRONT/right-facing rim area; use this project eye variant rather than the reference's stern yellow eyes. No mouth at ANY stage or pose, no eyebrows, no nose, no human arms/legs/feet/shoes. All animation comes from pad flex, edge curl, gentle sliding and attached flower petals. Reading order:1idleA;2idleB gentle pad breathe ripple;3walk1 pad flexes into right slide;4walk2 pad broadens flat;5walk3 opposite leaf edge curls while sliding;6walk4 settles;7attackwindup pad cups toward rear;8attackrelease pad front edge thrusts/cups RIGHT without mouth or effects;9attackrecovery pad relaxes;10hurt recoil eyes squeeze and pad wrinkles;11knockedOut1 eyes completelyCLOSED pad slumps slightly and attached flower folds if present;12knockedOut2 eyesCLOSED pad curls into a low wilted fold while remaining wide/flat;13cheer1 cheerful crescent eye arcs and leaf rim lifts gently;14cheer2 a different rim/petal lift with cheerful eyes;15SLEEP fullyCLOSED eye arcs, pad relaxed/cupped low and any flower half folded. Do not turn any pad curl into limbs or facial mouth. Keep all15frames distinct drawn poses, same anatomy and size; never substitute a sunflower, humanoid princess or standing flower creature.

variants.desc: Stage0 LILY PAD: canonical simple low flat rounded green lily leaf disk only, no bud or flower at this stage. Wide leaf bowl top visible, radial veins, raised green rim, clear back-left cleft. The pad itself is entire body. Keep flat and low, roughly 2.3 times wider than tall. Two dark oval eyes on near/right front rim, no mouth. No separate stem, roots, pedestal or base leaves below the pad. Walk is subtle pad sliding/flexing, attack is edge cupping, never stands upright.

Stage1 LOTUS PAD: natural project evolution of Lily Pad. Preserve a broad flat low green pad with cleft and dark oval eyes on its front rim. Add ONE attached moderately sized PINK LOTUS BLOSSOM at the REAR CENTER on a very short green stalk directly meeting pad, white-tipped pink pointed petals and warm gold center. Lotus blossom has NO face; eyes remain on PAD. Blossom modest enough that pad is dominant broad silhouette. Petals breathe/rock with idle, bob with pad slides, sweep rear in attackwindup, open wider in release, fold partially on KO/sleep. No royal crown, lotus is not sunflower.

Stage2 LOTUS QUEEN: natural project final evolution with a larger broad flat GREEN notched lily pad and ONE lush large multi-tiered PINK-and-WHITE LOTUS FLOWER rising just behind center. Layered pointed cupped petals, white outer petal tips, deep pink inner petals and warm golden seed center, a restrained small cluster of lotus buds at back edge optional. Pad stays wide and horizontal, strongly recognizable at every pose. Two friendly dark oval eyes only on PAD's front rim; NO face on flower, no mouth, no humanoid queen/crown/arms/legs. Queen is the rich lotus bloom, not a royal person. All flower/petals stay attached directly over pad, no tall upright character stem. Petals open/tilt naturally with attacks/cheer and close into low cupped bloom with closed pad eyes on KO/sleep.
